problem_type: Release rollout without bounded exposure and version health evidence
symptom: Every release reaches all eligible installations and generation failure signals have no version decision.
direct_cause: Promotion uploads updater metadata without a percentage; radar reports totals without a version decision.
class_root: Release visibility and expansion lack a shared validated policy boundary.
affected_population: Future stable release promotions and daily health runs
invariants: Both platform manifests use one validated integer percentage writer before upload.
Public mutations print a plan and require --yes.
Same-window version decisions never treat missing evidence as health.

door_reduction.why_not: Release artifact preparation and radar reporting remain separate commands: they own different states. The release-contract CLI prepares validated binaries; intake-radar alone gathers event records.

generality_proof: Platform manifests share planMetadata validation; daily decisions share buildVersionHealth after existing event flattening and automation exclusion, across capabilities, versions and result shapes.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate both manifests and checksums before any write.
Compare same-window evidence using the coordinated two-cohort interval policy and primary evidence guards.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Workflow contract requires the single rollout script before upload.
Report consumes the existing downloaded cache; regression yields nonzero.

recurrence.reason: Every future release and every platform can repeat the missing boundary.
same_class_scan: rg stagingPercentage .github scripts electron: no existing rollout writer
Read GitHubProvider and AppUpdater installed 6.8.9 sources; read telemetryEvents major/minor result contracts

prevention.invariant: Both manifests require explicit valid percentage; missing evidence never authorizes expansion.
prevention.failure_mode: Reject before writes; stop health decisions exit nonzero; insufficient primary evidence blocks full rollout.
prevention.strategy: One manifest writer and one cached-event decision function, with workflow boundary tests.

legacy_paths.rationale: Unconditional metadata upload preparation replaced by explicit rollout boundary. No second fetch pipeline introduced.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported updater retaining stable GitHub selection and staging semantics
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Installed source supports staging; validation must occur before publication because updater allows missing/NaN. No package installation in scope.
exit_criteria: Recheck installed source and official rollout docs on updater upgrade
If immutable releases become required, stop asset rewrite and coordinate an independent mutable feed or higher release

migration: Old manifests without percentage are accepted only as explicit rewrite inputs; new promotion always requires a percentage. Existing cache and incremental state unchanged.
residual_risks: Manual/tag downloads bypass staging; in-flight downloads cannot be recalled.
Telemetry lacks patch versions, true post-install completion and Agent turns; event cohorts do not control model/user mix.
GitHub multiple asset replacements are not atomic; a failed write must be investigated before expansion.
